scientific_integrity: The uniform result follows from matrix reduction and strict Perron comparison, not finite exhaustive checks. Date records the first verified public date of the 2003 lead source, not the date of this finding.
scientific_limitations: Uniform cyclic complex three-frequency sampling with exactly three erasures only; extension to more erasures or frequency masks is unproved. Relevant 1984–1985 prolate/burst-error primary full texts remained inaccessible, leaving specialized-prior-work risk.
title: Sharp three-erasure robustness for three-frequency cyclic sampling
